#Hobo.Face.scared
Hobo: I…{{wi}} I lost? {{wi}}{{punch}}NOOOO!
You: I guess we are pretty different after all. I can actually work hard when I put my mind into it, and you…{{wi}} Uh, to be honest, I don’t know that much about you…
Hobo: …
You: Anyway, I beat you, so now what?
Hobo: You will probably go back to your senses shortly…
Good, I was getting sick of this guy. Why the hell does he smell so bad even as an illusion?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: I heard that!
You: What?! How?!
Hobo: This is all in your head, you idiot! Of course I can hear everything! 
Hobo: Just because you beat me doesn’t mean I will allow you to disrespect me!
Hobo: Prepare yourself! 
H-{{wi}}He is charging at me!
